summary: First iteration full backend + frontend test of PlanSobrio MVP. 14/14 backend pytest passed covering auth, onboarding validation (amor+photos), seed data, discovery mode filtering, like/match reciprocity + system message, propose/accept plan, daily quota (20 -> 429), photo upload (Emergent object storage) + fetch, reasons CRUD, block/report + discover exclusion, admin dashboard/reports/users/ban+reactivate/activities+groups CRUD. Frontend flows passed: Landing content + CTAs, Admin login redirect to /admin with dashboard stats, demo1 login redirects to Descubrir, bottom nav 5 items, mode tabs (demo1 sees amistad+amor, demo2 does NOT see amor), 4 seed groups listed, group join, event visible, Necesito Apoyo has breathing + reasons + 3 phones (600 360 7777, *4141, 131) + SinAdicciones link, reason add works, register under-18 shows 'Debes ser mayor de 18 años' error. One critical UI bug found: bottom nav overlaps 'Me tinca' button on mobile viewport (Discover missing pb-nav padding).

minor.issue: server.py uses allow_origins=["*"] with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject cookies with wildcard origin. Not a blocker because frontend uses Bearer token from localStorage, but the httpOnly cookie set by /auth/login is effectively dead across origins.

Demo profile Fer_Cafe has modes=['amor'] and photos=[] — seeded directly bypasses onboarding validation. It will still appear in /discover?mode=amor since query is `modes: 'amor'`. Consider seeding at least a placeholder photo for demos that include amor.

ui_bugs.issue: Fixed BottomNav overlays the 'Pasar' / 'Me tinca ✨' action buttons on mobile viewport (420x900). Playwright reported 'subtree intercepts pointer events' 56 retries. Root cause: Discover container uses only `pt-6` but no bottom padding, while BottomNav is `fixed bottom-0` ~72px tall. Add `pb-nav` (defined in index.css as padding-bottom:6rem) to the outer div in Discover.jsx (line 92).
'Explorar la app' button label wraps to 3 lines inside a narrow pill on mobile (see screenshot). Consider shortening label or using icon-only on <640px.

issues: Bottom nav collides with action buttons — likely affects Groups, Chats, MisPlanes, Profile similarly if they don't use pb-nav utility.

action_items: Add `pb-nav` (or explicit `pb-32`) to the root wrapper of Discover.jsx (and audit Groups, Chats, MisPlanes, Profile, GroupDetail, ChatDetail) so BottomNav doesn't cover interactive content on short screens.
Consider fixing CORS: replace allow_origins=['*'] with explicit FRONTEND_URL when allow_credentials=True (Bearer-token auth still works, but cookie auth is broken across cross-origin).
Optionally seed at least one photo for demo profiles that include modo Amor so amor-discovery cards render properly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1146 lines — split routers into modules (auth, profile, discover, chat, groups, admin) for maintainability (>700 line rule).
CORS misconfiguration: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is silently ignored by browsers for cookie flows.
Discover.jsx and other AppShell pages must reserve space for fixed BottomNav (use pb-nav utility).

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (11/12 flows pass; me-tinca click blocked by nav overlay)

rca of the issue:
Bug: 'Me tinca ✨' un-clickable on mobile. RCA: <BottomNav> renders as fixed bottom-0 with pointer-events-auto on the inner card. Discover's ProfileCard occupies 70vh + action-buttons row appended below it. On viewport 420x900 (mobile) the actions row sits at ~y=780 while BottomNav card sits around y=804 — they overlap. Fix: apply pb-nav to the Discover outer wrapper (class already defined in index.css:109 as padding-bottom:6rem). Reproduction: login demo1@plansobrio.cl, on Descubrir tap 'Me tinca ✨' — click is intercepted by BottomNav.

Minor: Fer_Cafe seeded with modes:['amor'] and empty photos. RCA: seed_admin_and_data bypasses OnboardingIn validator. Not a bug per se but leaves a photo-less profile in the amor discover pool.
